root_cause.text: The error handling path (`err_free_skb`) in the `emac_tx_mem_map` function of the Spacemit K1 Ethernet MAC driver failed to release previously allocated DMA mappings when a mapping error occurred, resulting in a DMA mapping leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that under the `err_free_skb` label in `drivers/net/ethernet/spacemit/k1_emac.c`, a loop was added to iterate from `old_head` to `head` and call `emac_free_tx_buf(priv, i)` to clean up the mapped buffers, which were previously leaked when only `dev_kfree_skb_any(skb)` was called.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a resource leak in the TX mapping error path by freeing previously mapped TX buffers when packet transmission fails.
intent_record.what: Added a loop in the err_free_skb error path of emac_tx_mem_map to iterate from old_head to head and call emac_free_tx_buf on each descriptor index.
intent_record.how: This change ensures that any TX buffers mapped prior to encountering an error during packet transmission setup are properly cleaned up, preventing memory and DMA descriptor leaks.

The group's core intent is to fix a resource leak in the TX mapping error path by freeing previously mapped TX buffers, which directly addresses the described vulnerability of a DMA mapping leak in the error handling path of the TX memory mapping function.

candidates.rationale: This label marks the start of the error handling path which fails to unmap previously allocated DMA mappings before freeing the skb, leading to a DMA mapping leak.
The error handling path frees the socket buffer (skb) directly without first releasing the DMA mappings that were successfully mapped prior to the failure.

vuln_statements.explanation: In the error handling path, dev_kfree_skb_any(skb) is called to free the socket buffer, but it fails to unmap and release the previously allocated DMA mappings, leading to a DMA mapping leak.
This label marks the start of the error handling path which lacks the necessary cleanup code to unmap previously mapped DMA buffers before freeing the skb.
